notes: NAMING DEFECT RECORDED, NOT RESOLVED. The patent writes '2,2-dimethylpropanol (tert. amyl alcohol)' at lines 291 and 303, glossing the two names as one solvent. They are different compounds: 2,2-dimethylpropanol is neopentyl alcohol, a primary alcohol, while tert. amyl alcohol is 2-methylbutan-2-ol, a tertiary alcohol. Both are C5H12O. Which of the two was actually used cannot be determined from the document, so resolved is false and neither reading has been chosen. The printed gloss is kept as an alias, as is the hyphenated spelling '2,2-dimethyl-propanol' at line 303. This is the solvent of the first embodiment of the form C process: dissolution at 80 to 150 deg C, in particular 100 to 120 deg C, often at the boiling point, then rapid cooling.

Water is named at lines 303 and 305 only as an unwanted solvent: the solution used for the crystallization of form C is preferably essentially free of solvents including water other than 2,2-dimethylpropanol, or other than the hydrocarbon solvents, at not more than 10 wt. % and often 5 wt. %. It is not a crystallization medium in this section. Role is solvent because the patent itself groups it with the solvents. One record, merged from both appearances.

Feedstock for the crystallization: dissolved hot in 2,2-dimethylpropanol or in an aromatic hydrocarbon solvent, or in an aromatic-aliphatic mixture, and recovered as form C by rapid cooling, so role is reactant here while form C is the product. No bond is formed or broken. The section also offers amorphous tembotrione, mixtures of crystalline modifications and mixtures of amorphous and crystalline tembotrione as feedstock at line 307; those are the same substance and are not given separate records. Concentrations of 100 to 600 g/l and purities of at least 85%, 90% or 95% are stated as ranges and minima rather than measurements of a run, so quantity and purity_pct are null. Crystalline form C of tembotrione: the same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice, and not a distinct chemical entity. Formula C17H16ClF3O6S. This record is form C. The product of this process. Merged from its appearances as the crystallization product at lines 289 and 323 and as the seed crystals whose use makes rapid cooling unnecessary at lines 311 to 320. The stated crystallization extent of at least 60 or 80 wt. % and the form C content of at least 90 to 96 wt. % are rule-of-thumb minima for the process, not measurements of a run, so quantity, yield_pct and purity_pct are null.
